summary: Completed frontend testing of bug fixes for Mi Presupuesto (/budget), Dashboard, and SRI Limits pages. All 6 reported issues have been verified as FIXED.
passed_tests: 1. Botón 'Editar' en Ahorro bubble - WORKING: Clicking 'Editar' on Ahorro bubble switches to 'Ahorro e Inversión' tab correctly
2. Botón 'Editar' en Inversión bubble - WORKING: Clicking 'Editar' on Inversión bubble switches to 'Ahorro e Inversión' tab correctly
3. Burbuja de Viajes en /budget - WORKING: Viajes bubble is present showing $1,683.21/mes with 'Ver fondo →' link
4. Total Mensual Necesario - WORKING: Shows $13,539.21 with formula '(Gastos + Ahorro + Inversión + Viajes)'
5. Dashboard mobile view (375x667) - NO OVERLAPPING: Stat cards display correctly with responsive classes (text-base sm:text-xl lg:text-2xl, truncate)
6. SRI Limits mobile view (375x667) - NO OVERLAPPING: Summary cards display correctly in single column layout with responsive classes
7. Tabs functionality - WORKING: All 3 tabs (Categorías de Gastos, Proyección Ingresos, Ahorro e Inversión) work correctly
8. activeTab state - FIXED: useState for activeTab is properly defined at line 53 of PresupuestoEditable.js
critical_code_review_comments: Code quality is good - responsive classes properly implemented
Controlled Tabs component with activeTab state working correctly
Total Mensual Necesario calculation includes all 4 components (Gastos + Ahorro + Inversión + Viajes)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 reported bugs have been verified as fixed: 1) Edit buttons on Ahorro/Inversión bubbles now switch to 'Ahorro e Inversión' tab (activeTab state was added), 2) Viajes bubble appears on /budget page, 3) Dashboard stat cards have responsive classes preventing number overlap on mobile, 4) SRI Limits cards have responsive classes preventing number overlap on mobile, 5) Total Mensual Necesario includes Gastos + Ahorro + Inversión + Viajes, 6) All tabs work correctly.

bug_1_edit_buttons.details: activeTab state added at line 53 of PresupuestoEditable.js. Edit buttons call setActiveTab('metas') which switches to Ahorro e Inversión tab.

bug_2_viajes_bubble.details: Viajes bubble present at lines 324-357 of PresupuestoEditable.js, shows monthly_suggested_saving and savings_progress from travelFund API

bug_3_dashboard_mobile.details: Stat cards use responsive classes: text-base sm:text-xl lg:text-2xl, p-3 sm:p-6, truncate, min-w-0. Tested at 375x667 viewport - no overlapping.

bug_4_sri_limits_mobile.details: Summary cards use responsive classes: text-lg sm:text-2xl, p-4 sm:p-6, truncate, min-w-0. Tested at 375x667 viewport - no overlapping.

bug_6_tabs.details: Tabs component is controlled with value={activeTab} onValueChange={setActiveTab}. All 3 tabs work correctly.
